Initial release of report-generator-new.

- Generates structured technical reports in Markdown format.
- Follows a defined step-by-step process for gathering information and formatting.
- Uses external style guide and report template for consistent output.
- Ensures all required template sections are included in each report.
- Asks users for any missing key details before generating the report.
